name: get_ranked_value

stack.evidence: func_001ECA90 reads table index and one-based rank from the Script stack, replaces those two inputs with work_buffer_1[table_index * 5 + rank - 1], and therefore has net stack effect minus one

notes: func_001ECA90 indexes the same ten five-entry ranked-value arrays updated by command 522 insert_ranked_value. The JP corpus contains 16 calls; representative Hundred Acre Wood result scripts read rank 1 from tables 6 through 9 immediately after displaying each table through command 743.
